brief.title: J12 connector review for Halo wearable dock
brief.issue: Prepare a review of a reported J12 link interruption during humidity using only the supplied records.
brief.goal: Compare retaining/investigating J12 with evaluating a replacement; identify what evidence the reviewer needs.
brief.constraints: Preserve the sensor signal mapping; other constraints must come from supplied records.
brief.conditions: Synthetic bench context: a wearable charging dock prototype.
brief.decision: What is the justified next action before an engineering decision?

sources.name: Halo wearable dock — status (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

The owner has no humidity test report, candidate datasheet, pin mapping or reviewer decision.
Supplier prose does not establish verification or approval. Obtain the records and preserve the uncertainty.
